header: Each office with its address and contact
lead: Each card is headed by the office, because readers look for a place before a name. The role field holds the office and the text field holds the address.

contacts.title: The contact's name
contacts.text:
The address uses an address element
set upright, not in italics
and it keeps its line breaks

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his twenties.

contacts.title: A link is optional
contacts.text:
The contact row sits at the bottom of the card
so a four-line address lines up with a two-line one

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her fifties.
